changeLog: 2.0.0 | 2026-04-04 | 30-day trial+annual subscription via in-app Stripe checkout (no browser redirect, no license keys). LicenseManager.cs: trial tracking, online validation, machine ID binding, 7-day offline grace. Service gates all monitoring behind license check (IPC always active for activation). WebView2 intercepts Stripe success/cancel redirects. PHP backend: create-checkout, confirm-payment, validate, webhook endpoints. SQLite database for licenses/commissions. Self-service reseller portal with commission tracking. NSIS /RESELLER=CODE parameter writes reseller.json. Expired overlay locks GUI to activation-only screen. Trial countdown banner on dashboard.
